prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='DWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: The STL decomposition reveals CWT_catboost and DWT_catboost both achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), with DWT_catboost additionally leading in seasonality capture (0.6071) and overall RMSE (10.24). The extreme RMSE spread ratio (333.5) and high seasonality variance (0.745) indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit the complementary strengths of trend and seasonality champions. Early horizon specialist catboost (8.05 RMSE) differs from late horizon specialist DWT_catboost (10.05 RMSE), suggesting per-horizon weighting could further improve performance.
